The casing appears to be white plastic with a metallic or glossy finish around the screen bezel.

The click wheel lacks the crisp separation between the touch ring and the center button. It appears as a slightly melted or low-resolution white blob rather than a precise mechanical interface.
The perspective lines of the device's frame are slightly inconsistent, with the left and right bezels appearing to curve unnaturally rather than following a strict linear perspective.

Also, verify if the click wheel is a single flat circle or if it has the necessary depth/segmentation to be a functional interface. The screen content being a video instead of a menu is a semantic deviation but not necessarily a structural artifact; focus on the rendering quality of that content.
